subject: general
question: Which of the following Acts of Constitution, seeks to provide a common framework for the structure and mandate of urban local bodies to enable them to function as effective democratic units of Local Self Government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**74th Amendment Act, 1992**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 74th Amendment Act, 1992, was enacted to strengthen and empower urban local bodies (ULBs) in India.
 
• This Act provides a constitutional status to ULBs, ensuring regular elections and greater autonomy.
 
• It seeks to provide a common framework for the structure and functioning of municipal bodies, enhancing their efficiency and democratic governance.
 
• The 74th Amendment introduced Part IXA (The Municipalities) and the Twelfth Schedule to the Constitution, detailing the powers, authority, and responsibilities of Municipalities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urban Local Bodies (ULBs):**

 
 
• ULBs are institutions of local self-governance, including Municipal Corporations, Municipalities, and Nagar Panchayats.
 
• They are responsible for providing basic infrastructure and services such as water supply, sanitation, and urban planning.
 
 
 
• **Twelfth Schedule:**
 
 
• Introduced by the 74th Amendment, it lists 18 functions that Municipalities are responsible for, including urban planning, regulation of land use, and public health.
 
 
 
• **Part IXA of the Constitution:**
 
 
• Specifies the provisions related to the formation, structure, and functions of Municipalities.
 
• It aims to ensure democratic decentralization and enhance the role of municipalities in urban governance.
 
 
 
• **State Finance Commissions:**
 
 
• Constituted under the 74th Amendment to review the financial position of ULBs and recommend measures to improve their financial health.
